record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: Four units declare LEECH_SEED: Shroomish (1 star), Breloom (2 stars), Lileep (1 star) and Cradily (2 stars); none declares a passive. The strategy is shared; differences are the star index, maxPP and range.
record.summary: The caster heals itself by 20/40/80/160 (requested; by stars, with AP and crit scaling) and applies one poison stack to the cast target for 3000/6000/12000/24000 ms (requested; by stars). The cast heal is a fixed self-heal of the CASTER; it is not tied to damage dealt by the poison. Separately, Status.updatePoison computes a signed amount on each poison tick (5% of the poisoned unit's max HP per stack, passed through the listed multipliers and rounded): a negative result calls handleHeal on the POISONED unit, zero makes no call, and a positive result requests TRUE damage on the poisoned unit attributed to the poison origin. These are handler requests, not guaranteed final HP changes.

targeting.who: heal: the caster; poison: the cast target
targeting.note: The name suggests a drain, but the cast heals the caster once at cast time and no poison tick heals the caster. A tick can heal only the poisoned unit itself (negative computed amount, reachable in the code read only through the Gliscor passive formula).

effects.scaling: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost 1); x critPower only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT); x1.3 with BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED; x0.5 burn; x0.5 enraged; x1.2 ZENITH weather; Math.round
effects.resolution: applied heal = min(rounded value, missing HP), added to hp; returns 0 with no effect if the caster is wounded; skipped if the caster is protected or dead; overheal on a unit with the GRASS synergy effect adds max HP (0.4 x overheal). Caster healDone counts the effective heal only.
effects.label: cast self-heal of the caster (separate from the poison ticks)

effects.resolution: no effect if the target has IMMUNITY_POISON or runeProtect; stacks +1 up to a maximum of 3 (4 if the caster has VENOMOUS, 5 if TOXIC); applied duration = requested after Swift Swim / Hydration / Water Veil / Surge Surfer and Odd Keystone reductions; poison cooldown = max(current, applied)

effects.kind: poison tick (damage request, no call, or heal request)
effects.target: the poisoned unit, each time the poison tick fires (about every 1000 ms of update time while poison lasts)

declaredRaw.formula: round(maxHP x 0.05 x stacks x multipliers); negative -> heal request, zero -> no call
declaredRaw.stacksUsed: stacks (stacks - 2 for a holder of Passive.GLISCOR)

effects.scaling: poisonDamage = maxHP x 0.05 x stacks; GLISCOR uses (stacks - 2); rain x0.7; Assault Vest x0.5; TOXIC_BOOST x0.5; Swift Swim x0.7 else Hydration x0.5 else Water Veil / Surge Surfer x0.3; then Math.round. No AP or crit.
effects.resolution: negative result: pkm.handleHeal(round(-poisonDamage), pkm, 0, false), a heal REQUEST on the poisoned unit itself (handleHeal modifiers and the missing-HP cap apply; wound or protect make it do nothing); zero: no call at all; positive result: pkm.handleDamage with damage min(1)(round(poisonDamage)), attackType TRUE, attacker = poisonOrigin or null, shouldTargetGainMana false. Pinned-helper probe (GLISCOR holder, maxHP 1000, no weather, items or other modifiers): 1 stack -> heal request 50; 2 stacks -> no call; 3 stacks -> TRUE damage request 50. Every other unit uses stacks, so for them the result is never negative. The final HP change is decided by handleHeal / handleDamage (shields, protect, caps), not by this calculation.

statusEffects.effect: 1 stack added per application (cap 3, 4 with VENOMOUS, 5 with TOXIC on the origin); each tick requests TRUE damage, nothing, or a heal on the poisoned unit as described in the tick effect
statusEffects.applicationGuards: triggerPoison does nothing at all (no stack, no origin update, no passive or berry reaction) if the target has EffectEnum.IMMUNITY_POISON or its status has runeProtect. When it applies: GUTS passive gains +5 attack once (removed again at the end of the poison unless burned), TOXIC_BOOST gains +10 attack once (removed at the end) and halves ticks, and a held Pecha Berry is eaten (eatBerry; its effect was not traced). POISON_GAS on the unit re-applies a 1500 ms stack on every tick unless it holds Heavy Duty Boots.

starBehavior.note: Both tables are indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star entry is also the fallback. Listed units are 1 or 2 stars.

record.positionalConditions: None in the strategy beyond the cast target; range is 1 for Shroomish and Breloom and 2 for Lileep and Cradily.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: Single mode. Each cast adds one poison stack (up to the cap) and keeps the longer remaining poison cooldown; poisonOrigin is overwritten by the latest caster.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested (raw): cast heal 20 (1 star) / 40 (2 stars) for the caster; poison 3000 / 6000 ms. Applied: cast heal after AP, crit, heal modifiers, rounding and the missing-HP cap; poison duration after reductions, one stack, subject to immunity, Rune Protect and the stack cap. Poison ticks are separate from the cast heal: each tick is a handler request (heal on the poisoned unit, nothing, or TRUE damage) whose final HP effect is decided by handleHeal / handleDamage.
